is a email I’ve had to write this morning to another doctor to get my prescription, because the staff at this surgery refuse to prescribe the medication I’ve been taking for twenty years. I have applied to move to a different surgery as this one is very difficult to use.

Dear Doctor
I wanted to thank you for the liquid thyroxine prescription it has worked out really well. I have found it’s more stable the perfect amount for me seems to be 114 mg as per my t4, t3 and tsh levels which I test weekly. Unfortunately I am having trouble with my gp surgery (new Dover rd) and they only want to prescribe a bottle of 100 micrograms and won’t prescribe the bottle of 25micrgrams. I am moving to another GP. Would it be possible for you to prescribe me a bottle of 25 micrograms ?
I’m happy to pay
Best
Jim

I was here a few weeks ago and the nurse was incapable of taking blood, a very unpleasant experience digging around in both my arms with a needle, I’ve never had trouble giving blood before.

If you value your health stay clear of this practice

The staff seem to be on a power trip very keen to say what you’re not allowed to do unless you have permission from them. Protocol and bureaucracy and now an online booking system are a barrier to common sense. It’s very dangerous to have Unqualified administrators telling you what medication you can and cannot take. Look after yourselves this place is bad for your health.

It’s so bad they have a complaints department that told me my complaint was too old to be
